places-abrigo-del-molino-de-bagil-abrigo.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abrigo-del-molino-de-bagil-abrigo.story: 66 km from Socovos to Socovos, about 1 h 08 of riding. The stops in between: Fuente del Sabuco I, Abrigo de los Cerricos and back through Fuente del Sabuco I. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
